title: InvoCare Limited - proposed acquisition of Liberty Funerals

timeline.event: ACCC commences review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines. Market inquiries commence.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition

body_sections.Summary: InvoCare Limited - proposed acquisition of Liberty Funerals
body_sections.Market definition: The proposed acquisition was considered in the context of the Sydney market for the supply of funeral direction services
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 26 February 2007, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the increase in the merged firm's market share would be relatively small; - there will remain a number of alternative suppliers to which customers could turn, including in the local areas of Liberty Funerals' operations; - barriers to entry appear to be low; and - there do not appear to be any vertical foreclosure concerns raised by the proposed acquisition.
